actions.create_affiliate.description: Creates a new affiliate in Tapfiliate.
actions.create_affiliate.props.countryCo: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. US or NL.
Password for the new affiliate account.
actions.create_conversion.description: Creates a conversion in Tapfiliate. At least one attribution field is required: Customer ID, Referral Code, Tracking ID, Click ID, Coupon, or Asset ID + Source ID together.
actions.create_conversion.props.amount.d: Conversion amount used to calculate commissions.
The Tapfiliate asset ID. Must be provided together with Source ID.
The Tapfiliate click ID from the affiliate referral link.
actions.create_conversion.props.coupon.d: A coupon code linked to an affiliate to attribute this conversion.
actions.create_conversion.props.currency: Three-letter ISO currency code such as USD or EUR.
actions.create_conversion.props.customer: Your customer identifier to attribute this conversion to the matching affiliate.
actions.create_conversion.props.external: Your own unique identifier for this conversion, such as an order number.
actions.create_conversion.props.override: Override the maximum cookie time for this conversion.
actions.create_conversion.props.referral: The affiliate's referral code used to attribute this conversion.
actions.create_conversion.props.sourceId: The Tapfiliate source ID. Must be provided together with Asset ID.
actions.create_conversion.props.tracking: The Tapfiliate tracking ID stored in the affiliate click cookie.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_affiliate.description: Retrieves a Tapfiliate affiliate by ID.
The unique Tapfiliate affiliate ID. Find it on the affiliate detail page in your Tapfiliate dashboard.
actions.list_affiliates.description: Lists affiliates with optional Tapfiliate filters.
auth.description:
To obtain your API key:

1. Log in to your Tapfiliate account.
2. Open your account settings.
3. Find the API key section.
4. Copy the API key and paste it here.
